notes:
• A ticket now shows its description right under the title, so you can see what it's about without scrolling. Notes read as plain text, and the "Assigned" lines are gone.
• My time is now two columns. The calendar and your day stay on the left, and the form or ticket you open shows on the right.
• Days in the future only take PTO now.
• Every screen now says "Book time", where it used to be a mix of Log time, Add time and Save time.
• Support desk folds repeat emails and alerts from the same client into one row with a count. You can pick the whole group at once to close or assign it.
• Tickets you've picked in a list stay picked when you open one and come back. While anything is picked, a click picks or unpicks, and a double-click opens.
• Merging tickets keeps you on the list and tells you what merged into what.
• Sort in My tickets has a direction button, and it remembers your choice.
• A ticket opened beside a list has a clear Close button, and Esc closes it too.
• Sign out now asks first if you have a timer running or time waiting to send.
• Several fixes make sure time is never booked twice and never lands in the future.
